facts.text: The TUI includes a dedicated bottom input bar that activates upon a specific keypress (e.g., '/') to accept text queries.
NLP processing events (embedding, indexing, retrieving) are displayed in a dedicated live logging panel.
Search results display structured metadata (like scores and entities) using a table format.
Code snippets within the TUI are displayed with syntax highlighting.
